name: entry_set_background_color

name: rotate_bit_stream_right_once

name: shift_bitstream_by_count
description: Repeats a shift of the bit buffer right by one place for a count held in D1 (counting down to zero). When the buffer empties, it reloads from the previous longword with the top bit taken from the D7 flag bit.

name: entry_open_graphics_intuition_libraries

name: draw_glyph_into_two_planes
description: Converts a character code to a glyph index by subtracting 32 (clamped at zero), then writes eight glyph rows into two byte planes at a row stride of 80 bytes. The second plane receives each byte shifted right by one bit.

description: Upper-cases a file name, hashes it to choose a bucket, and walks that bucket's chain comparing names. On a match it copies the stored data block into memory, and it sets the disk sync and DMA registers around each attempt, retrying after a delay when the name is not found.

name: pulse_control_bit_and_wait
description: Clears and then sets the lowest bit of the byte register addressed by the pointer, calling the unnamed routine between and after the changes. It then polls a status byte at a fixed offset until its bit five is clear.

name: forward_call_preserving_d0
description: Calls the unnamed routine and returns the D0 register value it was given, unchanged.

name: relay_call_return_d0
description: Calls the unnamed routine and returns the D0 register value it was given, unchanged. It has three callers, while the similar routine above has one.

name: delay_polling_register_count
description: Repeats a timed wait for the number of passes passed in the data register, spinning on a memory read from the device register block on each pass. It returns once the count is exhausted.

name: read_disk_track_copy_match
description: Drives the disk control register for each attempt, searches the directory for a matching name, and on success copies the matched entry's data block into the destination buffer. Failed attempts are retried with a delay before the next try.

name: unpack_imp_packed_data_backwards
description: Checks the four-character IMP! tag at the start of a packed block, then unpacks it by reading bits from the end of the data. Back-referenced runs are copied into the output from the high end toward the start.

name: wait_for_cia_status_clear
description: Busy-waits on a status byte at a fixed device offset until its bit five is clear, then returns.

name: decode_mfm_disk_sector
description: Searches for the MFM sync word, rebuilds the data longwords from the odd and even bit fields using an alternating-bit mask, and checks an XOR checksum. Failed sectors are retried a limited number of times before the routine stops.

name: enqueue_longword_ring_no_return
description: Stores the longword from the address register into the 128-byte ring buffer at the current write index with wrap-around. On first use it arms the control register and sets the arming flag, and it returns no value.

name: dispatch_queued_routine_entry
description: Calls the code pointer stored in the current slot if the slot is set. Otherwise it clears the arming flag and sets the control register when the read index has caught up with the write index, and when entries remain it loads the next code pointer from the ring, advances the read index with wrap-around, and calls it.

name: advance_queue_and_call_entry

name: pop_call_next_queued_routine

name: call_two_routines_in_order

name: load_disk_entry_checksummed

description: Reads a disk track by DMA, locates the MFM sync words, and decodes each sector's odd and even bit fields into the buffer. It then runs a reorder pass that swaps 256-word blocks until none are out of order, and copies the blocks into place; a failed sync search ends the routine early.

name: merge_bits_under_mask
description: Returns the bits of the second input selected by the mask, combined with the bits of the first input selected by the same mask and shifted one place left.

name: store_step_and_set_direction
description: Stores the new value in a state word and sets a status bit. When the value has changed, it sets or clears a direction bit according to the sign of the difference, then calls the unnamed routine while its returned count is non-zero.

name: pulse_control_bit_with_delay
description: Waits for bit five of a status byte at a fixed offset to clear, then pulses the lowest bit of the control byte low and high. It then spins a fixed count of 3000 iterations before returning.

name: execute_unrecovered_routine_body

name: reset_channel_state_and_dma

name: interpret_sequence_stream_from_start

name: tick_channel_countdown_then_read

name: interpret_sequence_stream_with_header

name: tick_duration_and_resume_sequence

name: start_sequence_with_duration

description: Program entry that allocates copper-list, screen and load buffers from the system, zeroes the custom register block and a set of state longwords, and builds the copper list. It then loads and fades in the picture, waits, copies a transfer routine to a fixed address, and calls it.

key: helter skelter (1990)(audiogenic)[cr skr][t +3 skr]/Helter Skelter (1990)(Audiogenic)[cr SKR][t +3 SKR].adf:hs:0:00FE
name: copy_transfer_routine_and_call
description: Copies three longwords of the transfer routine to a fixed low-memory address and then calls that address.

key: helter skelter (1990)(audiogenic)[cr skr][t +3 skr]/Helter Skelter (1990)(Audiogenic)[cr SKR][t +3 SKR].adf:hs:0:0122
name: execute_unrecovered_transfer_code
description: A four-instruction routine whose pseudo-code is unavailable, copied to low memory and called from the entry. Only its size and its caller are recovered.

key: helter skelter (1990)(audiogenic)[cr skr][t +3 skr]/Helter Skelter (1990)(Audiogenic)[cr SKR][t +3 SKR].adf:hs:0:0158
name: load_decompress_and_fade_picture
description: Loads a file, fades the screen down, decompresses the picture, and then runs sixteen vertical-blank waits, each followed by a fade step.

key: helter skelter (1990)(audiogenic)[cr skr][t +3 skr]/Helter Skelter (1990)(Audiogenic)[cr SKR][t +3 SKR].adf:hs:0:0160
name: decompress_and_fade_picture_in
description: Decompresses the picture and then runs sixteen vertical-blank waits, each followed by a fade step, without loading a file or fading down first.

key: helter skelter (1990)(audiogenic)[cr skr][t +3 skr]/Helter Skelter (1990)(Audiogenic)[cr SKR][t +3 SKR].adf:hs:0:0170
name: wait_for_150_vblanks
description: Waits for 150 vertical-blank intervals, one wait per interval, and then returns.

key: helter skelter (1990)(audiogenic)[cr skr][t +3 skr]/Helter Skelter (1990)(Audiogenic)[cr SKR][t +3 SKR].adf:hs:0:017E
name: decompress_picture_chunks
description: Finds the chunks tagged CMAP and BODY, converts the sixteen-entry colour map into palette words, and unpacks the body with a run-length scheme. A negative count repeats the next byte and a positive count copies literal bytes, over 200 rows.
